records.title: Assemble-to-Order / Assembly Processing
records.memory_hook: The sales order can create the assembly object immediately.
records.deployment_scope: S/4HANA/Private or On-Prem classic assembly-processing pattern
records.business_difference: Compared with ordinary MTO, production-side execution can be created directly from sales-order processing instead of waiting for a later MRP planning cycle.
tests: create a sales item with assembly processing and assert the linked assembly object
short one component and assert the customer-confirmed date follows feasible assembly scheduling

records.title: Engineer-to-Order / Sales from Project Stock
records.memory_hook: The project exists because of the customer order, and the project becomes the execution backbone.
records.business_difference: WBS/project context owns stock, cost and engineering execution; the sales order remains the customer contract.
tests: assert the customer requirement is planned in the intended WBS/project segment
change an engineering-relevant structure and trace impact into open procurement/production before release

records.title: Sales Order Processing - Project-Based Services
records.memory_hook: Sales sells the promise; the customer project records how the work is delivered.
records.business_difference: Project execution evidence, not warehouse goods movement, drives cost and billing for service-oriented customer work.
tests: record time or external service cost and assert it reaches project margin and billing basis
change project stage and assert only allowed sales-order operations remain available

records.title: Recurring Delivery of Physical Products from Subscription
records.memory_hook: The recurring contract owns the lifecycle; generated sales orders execute each delivery cycle.
records.business_difference: Sales orders are generated execution documents; the long-lived commercial source of truth is the subscription-style contract.
tests: create recurring plan lines and assert one sales order per eligible delivery cycle
change the contract effective in the future and assert processed delivery-plan lines remain unchanged
